manuscript.title: The second moment of the hyperbolic Anderson model
manuscript.author: Le Chen
manuscript.change_from_previous: Revision a284420 makes two mathematical edits that the companion follows, and changes front matter (title, abstract, preface, a theory-outlook chapter, the reader edition, Appendices F (What Lean checks) and G (Approaches that do not work), the list of notation moved to the back). (1) notes/integrated_spatial_occupation.tex adds Lemma L:spatial-fourier-bound (statement 101-111, display E:spatial-fourier-bound at 106-109, proof 113-164): A_sp(g) <= 2^(1+alpha) R_alpha b^(alpha/2) under H:homog, Gamma = 0 allowed; the proof of P:spatial-smooth-ratio (label and statement unchanged) now derives R_0 < inf from it (proof lines 182-188) and keeps the finiteness of S_1^pos only for the score inequality (213-215). (2) notes/notes_stratonovich_ham_second_moment.tex replaces the smoothing and truncation sentence of L:damped-homogeneous-norms by the multiplier comparison E:damped-multiplier-comparison (statement 826-847, display 836-841, proof 894-917). Of the cited TeX inputs only these two files differ from 975feb3 among those with line citations. Every one of the 255 labels cited by the statement ledger, coverage.yaml, docs/coverage-scope-tex.yaml, claims.yaml, README.md, FORMALIZATION.md and the Lean doc comments exists exactly once at a284420; the 252 that also exist at 975feb3 are in the same file, and 249 have the same statement environment and proof up to whitespace and braces; the exceptions are P:spatial-smooth-ratio (proof), L:damped-homogeneous-norms (statement and proof) and the section S:spatial-occupation-foundation (the new lemma). The three new labels are L:spatial-fourier-bound, E:spatial-fourier-bound and E:damped-multiplier-comparison; E:intro-spectral-mass is newly cited and unchanged. 2888 TeX line citations were found (2755 after 'line(s)' and 133 further ranges and numbers in the same citations, e.g. 'proof 2660-2723' at 975feb3, 'proof 2733-2796' at a284420); 1386 moved, by a per-file line map (difflib) where the cited text is unchanged (checked: same text at both revisions), and 57 ranges inside the two edited passages were mapped by hand to the corresponding new passages; 25 citations of the removed passage on R_0 (lines 141-145 at 975feb3) were rewritten with the new content. Shifts: +1 to +73 in the main file, +68 to +72 in integrated_spatial_occupation.tex. A re-check then read every citation in a main-file or occupation-file context (1781) against a284420 and corrected 19 wrong locators (citations attributed to the wrong file and so shifted by the wrong offset or not at all, e.g. the zero-covariance remark 374-379 -> 444-449 and H^1 density 227-233 -> 262-268, and slips carried over from 975feb3, e.g. 825 -> 881, 89-90 -> 87-88) and widened 27 ranges that cut the cited text by a line.
